output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, the latest reported CleanSpark (NASDAQ: CLSK) figure I could verify was 78,749,690 shares sold short as of October 15, 2026. ChartExchange reports 31.94% of the float and 4.58 days to cover for that date; MarketBeat reports 31.32% of the public float for the same share count. A newer October 30 report was scheduled for release November 10, but I could not verify CleanSpark's figure, so these numbers should not be treated as a live reading.
caveats: The verified share count is dated October 15, 2026, not November 11; a newer reporting period was scheduled for publication, but its CleanSpark value could not be verified.
Float percentages differ by provider: ChartExchange reports 31.94%, while MarketBeat reports 31.32% for the October 15 share count.
